title: [finding][repo:objectui] Record drawer: width ignores the view's `navigation.width`, and the related list renders raw ids instead of record names
body:
**Finding, not a claim on anyone's queue** — filed by the video-production lane. Not taking this on. Two symptoms in the same surface; they may well be two fixes.

## 1. Drawer width ignores `navigation.width`

The view declares `navigation.width: '640px'`. The record drawer opens at **864px**. The declared value appears to have no effect.

## 2. Related list shows raw ids

Inside that drawer, the related list (Opportunity Line Items) renders **bare record ids** in place of the related records' names. A user sees identifier strings where they expect line-item names.

⚠ Symptom 2 is also a mild disclosure surface for the same reason as the `RECORD_LOCKED` toast (see sibling finding): raw ids land in screenshots and recordings.

## Environment

- `hotcrm` `main` @ `c716a2c` (17.4.0), `OS_PRODUCT_STAGE=ga`
- Opportunity record opened as a drawer from the kanban board

## What would resolve it for us

(1) `navigation.width` honoured, or documented as not applying to the drawer. (2) Related-list rows resolved to the target records' name field, with the id as a fallback only when no name is available.

Context: promo-video ticket steedos-labs/video-studio#356 (private repo; the finding above is self-contained).
